text:
Tractors have large tyres. These help to prevent the wheels from sinking into soft ground.
tractor
Which statement explains this?
A
Larger tyres exert a greater force on the ground.
B
Larger tyres exert a greater pressure on the ground.
C
Larger tyres exert a smaller force on the ground.
D
Larger tyres exert a smaller pressure on the ground.

options.label: A
options.text: Larger tyres exert a greater force on the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: Larger tyres exert a greater pressure on the ground.

options.label: C
options.text: Larger tyres exert a smaller force on the ground.

options.label: D
options.text: Larger tyres exert a smaller pressure on the ground.
